root_idea.summary: The root centers on referring an affair to another and relying on that party to handle or arbitrate it.
root_idea.development: From this principle develop reciprocal arrangements in which parties share, equalize, exchange, mix, or leave matters without a single controlling authority.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.

senses.definition: To entrust or commit an affair to another, referring its handling or arbitration to that party.
senses.usage_conditions: Constructed with إِلَى and an object such as أَمْر; in the Quranic usage, the speaker refers his case to God as arbiter while abstaining from contention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Giving a woman in marriage without stipulating a dowry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal marriage construction; it may also involve waiving the dowry requirement or leaving the dowry matter without specification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose marriage is contracted without a stipulated dowry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term also covers a woman who waives the dowry ordinance, or, in variant usage, one whose guardian contracts the marriage without naming a dowry or leaves the dowry matter to her.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Comprehensive copartnership in which everything possessed by the partners is held in common.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially in the legal expression شِرْكَةُ المُفَاوَضَةِ, contrasted with partnership limited to a particular asset or affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mutual conferring in which each party receives what the others have to communicate and contributes what he possesses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied particularly to learned discussion and exchange of knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Competing with another in an affair by matching or emulating what the other does.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructed with فِي for the affair or matter in which the parties compete.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For partners to share property altogether and stand as equals in the partnership.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of two partners whose property is jointly held in its entirety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confer or converse mutually, exchanging what each party has to communicate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With الحديث, it can mean to enter upon or engage in discourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mix together in social intercourse.
To compete with one another in an affair, each doing as the others do.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The competition is expressed with فِي for the relevant affair or matter.
Used as a noun related to مُفَاوَضَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group whose members are undifferentiated equals, mixed or dispersed, and have no chief or commander.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe people or other groups in a condition of disorderly separation or mixture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Common or promiscuous property held among a group without division.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may indicate that members freely take or use the common goods.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collective affair left in a mixed or unregulated state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In أَمْرُهُمْ فَوْضَى, members freely use one another’s possessions or act without consulting or obtaining one another’s authorization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The remaining signs or residue of life in a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression رَأَيْتُ التَّفْوَاضَةَ لِفُلَانٍ or بِفُلَانٍ.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence is an imperfect active Form II form; the public headword is normalized to the standard perfect citation form فَوَّضَ.
